in_season_2026.role_shift_notes: Dominant goal-line equity; 4 rushing TDs through 3 games. Alpha QB anchor.
Protected by NFL #1 offensive line (88.8 PFF); clean pocket distributor with 6 TDs.
Rushing floor unbeatable; averaging 74 rush yards per game.
Scored lone Philly TD in Chicago; tush push remains core red-zone engine.
Dominant bellcow: 37.9 FP Week 3 explosion; 4 total touchdowns through 3 weeks.
154 rushing yards and 22.4 FP in Week 3; absorbing goal-line volume.
Erupted for 194 rush yds, 2 TDs (37.3 FP / 55.95 MVP) in Week 3. Consensus RB1.
High floor in full-PPR formats; consistent 5+ targets weekly.
Starting lead running back for Houston Texans; splits touches with Woody Marks.
God-tier 50% first-read rate; unstoppable inside intermediate crossers.
Traded to Buffalo Bills to become Josh Allen's clear WR1 perimeter separator.
Quiet Week 1 box score due to Cleveland shadow, but 32% first-read and 0.29 TPRR remain elite.
55% first-read share despite heavy double teams. Best pure route runner in the NFL.
Exploded to 130 yards on 32% first-read. Operating as Allen's intermediate security blanket.
Commanded 8 targets in Week 1; high touchdown regression candidate.
Clear RB2 behind Gibbs in Detroit; trusted on 3rd down passing reps with Montgomery in Houston.
Commands 40% of goal-line TE targets in Buffalo's 38% 12-personnel red zone packages.
Anchors Indianapolis boundary as primary shadow CB1 funneling targets inside.
Acquired by Los Angeles Rams; shadows opposing WR1s across all alignments.
Undisputed #1 shadow corner in NFL. Eliminates primary boundary receivers.
Undisputed #1 shadow corner in NFL.
Rejoined Kansas City secondary playing physical press and nickel packages.
Starting outside cornerback for Indianapolis Colts opposite Sauce Gardner.
Threw for 328 yards and 3 TDs in Week 3 win; Ryan Grubb scheme maximizing JSN, Cooper Kupp & Rashid Shaheed.
Usurped starting backfield command post-Week 3 (22.1 FP, 14 car, 86 yds, TD, 4 rec). Priority starter for Week 4 TNF.
Exploded in Week 3 with 23.0 FP (6 tgt, 5 rec, 68 yds, 2 TDs). Immediate #1 waiver TE add.
Starting RB for Cleveland Browns; primary early-down and goal-line back for Week 4 TNF.
